items.name: city-fruit-stall
items.visualResult: Three produce trays, open striped canopy, four supports and intact underside; original atlas looks consistent at both native sizes.
items.floorContacts: Worker confirmed four contacts,9mm snap; main read report and inspected underside, did not repeat contact grouping.
limitations: Full city placement/routes/lawn masking not yet accepted.

items.name: city-bike-rack
items.visualResult: Two whole static bicycles, four wheels, rack and coloured frames preserved; drivetrain omitted intentionally in the approved toy reference.
items.floorContacts: Worker wheel-specific UV/rubber analysis confirms 4 tyres; main reviewed it, did not repeat numerical wheel contact grouping.
limitations: Full city placement/routes/lawn masking not yet accepted.

items.name: city-playground
items.visualResult: Connected slide, ladder, A-frame and single stationary swing; rods and seat preserved, no broad ground plate.
items.floorContacts: Worker checked9 supports+slide end; lower75mm flattened to remove up to71.55mm source gaps, normals recomputed. Main reviewed report/images; 98 central-window rays are worker evidence, not full-volume certification.
limitations: Full city placement/routes/lawn masking not yet accepted.
